subject: Customer engagement stack — bakeoff outcome and procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Customer engagement bakeoff — final scorecard and recommended path

Hi team,

Thanks for sitting through the demos this week. Attached is the consolidated bakeoff scorecard (sheet per vendor) and the vendor pricing summary. Short summary up top:

- Intercom + Gainsight (integrated approach) scored highest on product fit and time-to-value.
- Zendesk remains the lowest-cost single-platform option but would require additional integration work to match our success workflows.
- Security/compliance: all vendors passed our baseline questionnaire; Zendesk flagged a few data residency clarifications for EU—we'll track that if region becomes relevant.

Recommendation: pursue a 12‑month commercial pilot with Intercom for messaging + Gainsight for customer health/expansion signals. Pilot would cover core legal and data controls, a >3 month integration window, and an opt-in migration plan for key accounts (including Acme Health).

Next asks from procurement/legal:
- Commercial term we want: 12 months pilot + automatic review (no auto-renew)
- Target discount band: 18–25% (volume + multi-product)
- SLA expectations: 99.95% monthly uptime for critical routing, priority escalation path.

I've flagged items in the attached bakeoff-scorecard where we need formal commitments (column: ProcurementActions). Please review and let me know blockers by EOD tomorrow so I can prep the vendor calls.

Attachments: bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx (xls), vendor-pricing-summary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Marissa — thanks for this. High level looks good and aligns with the exec ask to prioritize short time-to-value. A couple of questions from procurement/finance perspective before we engage procurement at Acme: 

1) What are the expected first-year total costs for the pilot (Intercom + Gainsight bundled) — can finance get a line-item estimate we can commit to? (See vendor-pricing-summary but need 'committed pilot price')
2) Migration effort: what is the minimal viable integration to get Acme onboarded in 8 weeks?
3) Risk: if Intercom has any hard limits on concurrent messaging or API TPS we should know now.

I'll loop finance and legal once we have the committed pilot price and a short SOW draft. If everyone is comfortable, I'll ask Neha to surface our recommended commercial language and any standard concessions.

Karthik

Hi Karthik & Marissa,

Thanks for sharing the scorecard and recommendation — Acme is supportive of piloting Intercom for messaging (we lean toward a single inbox per product team). A few asks from our side: 

- Can you commit to an 8-week onboarding window for the first product inbox? We need the integration with our SSO (Okta) and the ability to export conversation-level transcripts to our data warehouse.
- Pricing: we operate on a PO model and will need a clear pilot price to route to procurement (we've historically targeted a 6–9% vendor admin fee; please include that line in the commercial summary).
- Security: we'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an org-level data processing addendum.

If you can send an SOW + pilot price by Monday, we can prioritize the internal approval.

Olivia Barnes

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme-health.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Zendesk Sales <zendesk-sales@zendesk.com>, Intercom Commercial <sales@intercom.com>, Gainsight Rep <gainsight-ops@example.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Commercial proposal (Intercom + Gainsight) — pilot summary & ask

Hi Olivia, Karthik, Marissa — looping vendors into the thread so we can get a tight SOW and committed pilot pricing. Draft summary below (see attached vendor-pricing-summary.pdf for line-item costs):

Pilot scope (12 weeks):
- Intercom: single product inbox, SSO (Okta) integration, basic automations, and analytics.
- Gainsight: account health dashboards, renewal risk signals, and playbooks for high-value customers.
- Data flow: daily exports to Acme warehouse + conversation transcript export on demand.

Commercial ask (pilot):
- Intercom license + implementation: $38,000 (one-time implementation) + $28,000/mo subscription (up to 3 product inboxes).
- Gainsight license: $25,000/mo (pilot scope limited to 500 named accounts).
- Combined vendor discount requested: 20% off list for the 12-month pilot term.
- SLA addendum and DPA to be included in the SOW.

Procurement notes for Acme PO: please include an explicit pilot end-date and 'migration opt-in' clause for later migration to a single-vendor solution if desired. I've attached a short legal-exception-request.docx for the DPA exceptions we expect vendors to sign.

Vendors: please confirm you can provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a one-week turnaround on a redline-ready SOW.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Final decision: move forward with Intercom + Gainsight pilot — procurement asks & next steps

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on the scorecard and Acme's timeline, we will move forward with the Intercom + Gainsight integrated pilot for Acme Health. Action items and owners below: 

1) Neha — confirm final commercial commitment with vendors (one-week turn). Nail down a combined pilot price that fits within the range in the vendor-pricing-summary and include the 20% targeted discount. Confirm SOC 2 Type II evidence delivery dates.
2) Marissa — produce a 2-page SOW (pilot scope, success metrics, migration opt-in clause, pilot end date) and share with legal. Target EOD Monday.
3) Laura (Finance) — prepare a committed pilot budget line and confirm we can accept a PO model. Also confirm if we should float any initial implementation costs.
4) Legal (cc'd separately) — prepare a DPA + SLA addendum and review the legal-exception-request.docx for items we can concede.
5) Olivia & Acme Procurement — please circulate the internal PO timeline; we will time vendor SOW delivery to match your procurement window.

I'm attaching the final bakeoff scorecard again and a link to the HubSpot deal (HS-34219). Once Neha confirms vendor pricing, I'll issue the internal approval to start contract negotiations and SOW finalization.

Attachments: bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx
Related: https://hubspot.com/contacts/record/HS-34219
